scripts.sweep: pnpm run clean && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build
scripts.test:api: pnpm -F @vault/db run build && pnpm -F api run test:api && pnpm -F api run test:html:api
scripts.prismigrate: pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prismareset: pnpm exec prisma migrate reset --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.boot: concurrently -n API,WEB,WORKER -c auto "pnpm -F api run dev" "pnpm -F web run dev" "pnpm -F api run worker:dev"
scripts.start: pnpm run localdocker && pnpm run build && concurrently -n API,WEB,WORKER -c auto "pnpm -F api run start" "pnpm -F web run start" "pnpm -F api run worker"
scripts.docker:build: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:rebuild-clean: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml build --no-cache && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans
